subject: PO vs Card — procurement next steps / vendor onboarding (FinOpsCo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finopsco.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: PO vs Card — procurement next steps / vendor onboarding (FinOpsCo)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end after the discovery call: 

- Procurement posture: you mentioned AP prefers purchase orders for anything over $10k and vendor onboarding typically takes 2–3 weeks.
- Commercial path: you’re evaluating between placing a PO (standard contract + PO) vs using a corporate card for an initial POC to speed things up.
- Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood is available in the Cloud Marketplace — short answer: we’re listed in AWS Marketplace (private listing available) and can support marketplace purchase orders, but we’ll need to confirm billing integration timelines.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach a draft SOW and onboarding checklist for your procurement team to review (attached).
2) Can you confirm whether you have a preferred contract template or redlines we should expect?
3) If a PO path is required, please share onboarding contact + required vendor fields (W-9, DUNS, remit address). If you prefer to start on card for a limited POC, confirm limits and billing owner.

If helpful, happy to set a 30-min call with our finance/ops (cc’d) to go through vendor onboarding and any marketplace questions.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (Excel, stub)

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@finopsco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finopsco.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO vs Card — procurement next steps / vendor onboarding (FinOpsCo)

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the docs. Quick answers from procurement side: 

- AP policy: For new vendors we generally require a PO for any recurring contract and for one-time payments > $10k. For smaller POCs we can sometimes use our company card, but it requires a cardholder and approval.
- Vendor onboarding: We need a completed onboarding form (I attached our standard questions below) plus a W-9 and vendor remit info. We also require either DUNS or our internal vendor ID — if you don’t have DUNS we can issue a temporary vendor number while we process tax docs.
- Marketplace: We prefer marketplace purchases when available because billing flows through procurement, but it can add a month to set up. If you can provide a private listing and provide the pricing sku, that helps speed approvals.

I’m happy to do a short call with your finance/ops team this week. Could you have someone from Redwood confirm the PO terms (net30 vs net45) and whether you accept marketplace PO references?

Also, our procurement lead is CC’d (procurement@finopsco.com) — they’ll send the official vendor onboarding spreadsheet and checklist.

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Finance Operations | FinOpsCo
sam.patel@finopsco.com

---Quoted onboarding stub from Procurement Team (sent in separate attachment)---
(Procurement asks: legal entity name, tax ID, W-9, remit address, accounts payable contact, DUNS or internal vendor ID, sample invoice, insurance cert if contract > $50k)

Folks — forwarding Sam’s note. Two asks for finance/legal ops: 

1) Pricing/terms: FinOpsCo expects PO for recurring contracts and prefers marketplace when possible. They asked whether Redwood can accept PO references (yes/no) and standard payment terms (we typically offer Net30; can we consider Net45 as an exception for mid-market deals?).

2) Vendor docs: Procurement needs W-9, DUNS (or temporary vendor ID), remit address, and our standard invoice sample. I’ve attached a draft SOW — can legal quickly review the indemnity/liability clauses to see if any redlines are likely?

Jonas — can you own the vendor onboarding call? Lauren — can you confirm whether we can offer a marketplace private listing (and estimated time to enable)? I’ll coordinate scheduling with Sam.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (same as above)

Marissa / Lauren / Sam —

Happy to take the onboarding call. Proposed plan: 

- I’ll join a 30-min sync with Sam & procurement to walk through required vendor fields and timeline. I’ll bring our onboarding checklist and sample invoice.
- We can accept PO references on invoices (our billing supports PO ids). Standard payment terms are Net30; we can agree to Net45 for this one as a sales exception if legal signs off.
- Lauren — if you can confirm marketplace SKU availability by EOD Friday, we’ll present both paths to FinOpsCo on the call (marketplace vs direct PO).

Sam — are you available Fri 26 Jun at 11:00 AM PT for a 30-min call? If that doesn’t work, propose two windows and we’ll accommodate.
